push.title: Daily reminders
push.intro: One gentle notification a day, at the hour you choose, so you don't forget the 3 minutes of play.
push.consent: If you turn reminders on, we keep on the Ludiko server only: the technical notification address of this device, the chosen hour, the time zone, the language and the date of the last day played. We do not keep the child's name, grade or progress. We use this only to send at most one notification a day, and none if the child has already played. You can stop it any time: when you turn reminders off, we delete everything we kept.

family.title: Parent account

family.intro: With a parent account, your children's profiles and progress sync between phone, tablet or a grandparent's phone. Without an account, everything stays on this device only.

consent.title: What we save in the account
consent.storedIntro: To sync children between devices, we save in the cloud:
consent.stored1: the nickname, avatar, school grade and language of each synced profile;
consent.stored2: learning progress: skill states, stars, stickers, play days, missions and check results.
consent.never: real names, birth dates, photos, the child's email, answers to individual exercises, location.

exam.title: National exam practice

entry.title: National exam practice
entry.body_en2: We practise how it feels in grade II, to get used to it. No stress!
entry.body_en4: We practise how it feels in grade IV, to get used to it. No stress!

picker.intro: Pick a practice test. You can do as many as you like, any time.
picker.parentNote: This is a practice simulation, not an official grade. Ludiko builds the tests like the real papers (parts, kinds of questions, time) but with original questions. The result is an estimate to show what is still worth practising.
picker.unavailable: This test is not ready yet.
picker.optionalNote: When the science lessons are ready, questions from them will appear here too.

start.title: Ready to start?
start.body: You answer the questions one by one. You will not see whether you got one wrong during the test, just like in a real exam. At the end we make a practice plan together.
start.timerHint: The clock is only a helper. If time runs out, you can carry on calmly.
start.empty: We could not prepare the test right now. Try again later.

runner.pausedBody: Take a deep breath. The clock is stopped. We carry on when you are ready.
runner.timeUpBody: No rush: you can work a little longer or see the results now.
runner.exitBody: If you leave now the test is not saved. You can start a new one any time.

results.title: You finished the test!
results.body: You worked like a true champion. Thank you for trying!

parent.title: For parents
parent.disclaimer: Practice simulation, not an official grade. The calificativ below is a Ludiko estimate made with the rules in the table.

parent.practiceBody: These topics had wrong or unanswered questions. Each button starts a short practice game.
